name: saas-alerts-mcp
description: All four SaaS Alerts APIs, plus cross-customer alert triage, the Respond approval queue and account containment.

saas_alerts_base_url.title: SaaS Alerts API host
saas_alerts_base_url.description: Sets SAAS_ALERTS_BASE_URL. Leave blank for the SaaS Alerts API host (https://us-central1-the-byway-248217.cloudfunctions.net); set it only to send requests through your own proxy or a test server.

saas_alerts_api_key.title: SaaS Alerts partner API key
saas_alerts_api_key.description: Sets SAAS_ALERTS_API_KEY, the partner API key from SaaS Alerts Settings. It is sent as the api_key header to the Reports, Manage and Webhooks APIs, and the server exchanges it for the Respond access token.

saas_alerts_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
saas_alerts_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

saas_alerts_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
saas_alerts_mcp_read_only.description: Set to exactly 1 so saas-alerts_execute runs GET endpoints only, contain, rule-triggers decide and subscriptions health can only preview (--confirm is refused), and sync, import and export are not offered. Leave blank for full access. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

saas_alerts_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
saas_alerts_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not enforced by this connector: there are no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here does not limit which customers a call can reach. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, turn on the read-only MCP server.
